lines: What’s the difference between you and me?
We’re the same kind of creature, you know.
I wish everyone felt the same.
Who laughs when we live recklessly?
It’s too early to finish all the sorrow.
Even today, when I can call it happiness,
even today, when dreams are defeated and I’m broken,
Ah, I’m still pressing my feet forward without giving up.
even how to fly toward the sky,
we forget it as we grow up.
even the wounds that never fully heal,
We gain and lose each day—does it mean anything?
There are feelings that will never be conveyed,
maybe it would be a little easier.
That I’m not the only one,
I wonder if I can believe it.
even today, my cheeks wet as I fall asleep,
Ah, it’s far from being a lament.
To the flower that blooms in winter
We run across the snowy earth
not forgetting the spring that was too blue
I want to stay remembering it
we speak of a map with friends
we run along the road of people
and that, they say, is the trail
What’s the difference between you and me?
each of us has the scenery we’ve seen
I will live now as myself
